name: Desolate Essence
text: Desolate essence: confluence essence. The Desolate essence, like all confluences, is impacted by the essences that make it up, with the types of abilities it tends to awaken including drain attacks, debuffs and zone spells. Drain attacks include the usual health an mana drain, but Desolate specifically will often have an ability to drain aspects of the environment, depending on the essences that make it up. This is a distinctive traits of the Desolate confluence, where most essences enhance the aspects of the essences that make it up, Desolate often weakens them. Many Desolate combination involve the Death essence and are accordingly restricted. These combinations are usually characterised by the unnatural destruction its abilities cause. Other combinations tend to be related to natural forms of desolation, like deserts. Known combinations: Sand + Wind + Sun = Desolate - desert combination. Mana drain, stamina drain, withering powers, giant sand worms, sand storms.; Ice + Earth + Wind = Desolate - a tundra-themed combination that might include wide area cold and mana burn abilities, possibly with summoning powers for wolf and fox type creatures.; Locust + Plant + Hunger = Desolate - a classic plague of locusts combination that desolates the landscape to grow in power. Not a restricted combination but one looked unfavourably on by local communities, due to the damage it tends to do the the landscape.; Locust + Blood + Hunger= Desolate - also a plague of locusts, but likes steak over salad. This combination is restricted, despite not including any restricted essences. Summoned locusts swarms are notoriously hard to control with precision, and a few loose gold-rank locusts with a thirst for blood encountering a village can go very wrong.; Plant + Hunger + Death = Desolate - a restricted combination, due to the Death essence and the fact that this combination can turn fertile land into barren earth, draining its vitality..

name: Leonid
text:
Leonid:
Members of the Leonid race look like large anthropomorphic lions. Their race has better stamina recovery and less stamina consumption compared to other races.
Known Leonid:
 - Gareth Xandier (Gary)
 - Natalie
 - Marcus (Book 10)
Racial Gifts:
The Leonid racial abilities mostly focus on improving their own physical abilities as well as those of their allies.
 - Ancestral Strength: Increased physical strength.
 - Ancestral Swiftness: Increased speed and reflexes.
 - Boon Aptitude: More likely to awaken boon-related essence abilities; boon abilities have increased effect. (boons are buffs)
 - Tireless: Resistant to stamina drain. Essence abilities consume less stamina to use.
 - Sprint: Run at extreme speed for extreme stamina cost.
 - Leonid's Roar (boon): Roar loudly to increase the [Power] and [Speed] attributes of nearby allies.

name: Celestine
text:

The Celestine race has metallic colour hair, with matching eyes. They are known to have Astral and Holy affinity. As essence users, they tend to get more special abilities than spells or special attacks. Their skin colouration has been noted to range from alabaster to dark chocolate.
Celestines are not a naturally occurring race unlike most others, instead they come about as the offspring of a pair of outworlders. Celestines are also able to reproduce among themselves.
Known Celestines:

 - Dawn
Racial Gifts:

name: Outworlder
text:
Each outworlder is summoned or pulled, usually against their will, from one world to another through the deep astral as a disembodied soul. In the process of being pulled, the outworlder "dies" and is reborn in the new world.
Although outworlders can be of any race or appearance before becoming an outworlder, it is mentioned that outworlders naturally smell like springtime. This appears to be regardless of their race of origin.
Known Outworlders:
 - Jason Asano pulled from Earth to Pallimustus at the start of the story.
 - Rufus's unnamed friend who visited the Remore Academy. Female.
 - Farrah Hurin after being resurrected on Earth.
 - The Founder. Established groups of essence users on Earth several centuries ago.
 - Unknown outworlder located somewhere in Rimaros.

 - ~100 Earth natives as a side effect of interrupting a mass summoning Ritual on Pallimustus.

 - *Darryl (A troll were-crocodile. The only non-essence user to be transported in the incident.)
 - *Koa 
Racial Gifts:
When each Outworlder is reborn, their racial gifts are not a standard set as they are for other races. Instead, the abilities are formed by their soul to help aid them in the world they will find themselves in. The only exception to this is Astral Affinity, which is shared by all outworlders. It is not always the case that all racial gifts are transformed.

name: Brightheart Smoulder
text: Brightheart Smolder are a sub-species of the smolder race. Their features are a mix of other races, they have hair and eyes of red, ember, obsidian, ash and molten colors that shift or change. Also, they have runes on their skin resembling runics these are easily visible. They were created when some smolders went into a natural array and became modified. These are more magical so there aura senses are weaker but there magic senses are heightened. They are to magical to consume essences or have racial gifts but have their own abilities. The common types of magic are fire, stone and ash. Although the rarer ones are steel and lava. The stone and steel ones can manipulate and/or create their respective materials. While the fire, ash and lava people create them and can send them flying as attacks. Some fire and ash abilities let them fly.

name: Garuda
text:
Tends to produce armored strikers

name: Races
text:
Terminology:
Natures, otherwise known as races refer to the species and sub-species of a creature. The terms can be used interchangeably, with the change to the use of "Nature" over "Race" coming from the appearance of The System which uses the term due to the vast range of creatures and others capable of using essences.
Known Natures:
Essence Capable Natures:
Known Essence Capable Natures:
 - Outworlder
 - Celestine
 - Draconian
 - Elf
 - Goblin
 - Human
 - Lehenik
 - Leonid
 - Merfolk
 - Runic
 - Smoulder
 - Valash
Other Essence Capable Natures:
 - An unnamed earth-affinity species with gemstone-like scales covering their bodies. They are not known in Pallimustus but Dawn is mentioned to recognize them. (Appeared in a transformation zone located in Pudong, China)
Magical Races:
There are many natures of creature that are similar to the essence capable races while lacking the ability to gain essences due to thier higher natural magic. They come in many forms but naturally are born at iron rank or above.
Known Magical Races:
 - Brightheart Smoulder
 - Messenger
Racial Abilities:
Creatures across the universe each posses six abilities inherent to their nature. For some these abilities can undergo an evolution later in life to take on abilities that reflect the soul of the ability's holder. It is not made clear if all creatures are able to recieve a gift evolution however; all known essence capable natures have been seen to posses the potential for it.

name: Adventure Society
text:
The Adventure Society is one of the major organizations in the world. Its main purpose is to handle monster extermination.
The Adventure Society issues monster notices which can be taken from a notice board or the Adventure Society directly. Each notice has three pieces of information so long as that information is known. The name of the monster, or a description, the number of monsters, and the approximate location.
The first step to joining the adventure society involves registering an application and a physical assessment.  This invoves filling out one's personal details and a magical scan of the applicants physiology and essences with an official from the magic society, adventure society and a clergy member of Knowledge present. The appalicant's aura is read, recorded and their essence combination checked against the restricted list. The applicant is then scheduled for a field assessment.
For the field assessment, the applicant has their physical and essence abilities tested as well as their ability to made good decisions and plan under pressure.
The Adventure Society insignia is a sword and rod across a shield.
Greenstone Branch:
 - Director: Elspeth Arella
 - Deputy Director: Genevieve Picot
 - Official: Vincent Trenslow
 - Official: Albert Bertinelli

name: Adventure Society Badge
text:
An adventure society badge is a magical item, given to a member of the Adventure Society. It has a lot of functions:
 - It functions as identification.
 - It allows adventurers to make copies of Monster Notifications.
 - It allows the Adventure Society to track its members and how many monsters they kill.

name: Magic Society
text:
The Magic Society is one of the major organizations in the world, being a place for learning and research of magic and essences.
the Magic Society along with the Adventure Society and the Alchemy Association are t the major organizations of Pallimustus.
(More to be added)

name: Alchemy Association
text: The  Alchemy Association is an organization located in Pallimustus.

name: The Red Table
text:
The Red Table is a cannibalistic cult in Pallimustus.
The Vane family was leading a branch of this cult in Greenstone.
Jason, Rufus, Farrah and Gary first met while they were captured by this cult to be a sacrifice in a ritual to summon a Sanguine Horror.

name: Spirit Coin
text:
Spirit coins are the currency of Pallimustus. They are a concentrated source of raw magic adventurers can consume to sustain themselves. Is someone consumes a spirit coin that is of a higher rank than they are, all of their attributes are raised to that rank for a short amount of time. After this boost of power, it leaves the consumer exhausted and enervated.
[Lesser Spirit Coin] (iron rank, common):
An impure distillation of raw magic. (currency, crafting material).
Effect: Used to fuel lesser-rank magic items or as a ritual component.
Description: A coin with a washed-out blue colour, with a metallic sheen. It feels like glass to the touch. Usually there is something embossed on the coin. The coins that are generated by Jason's Interface ability have an image of Jason himself, giving a thumb's up. The other side is engraved with text, reading: "PRODUCT OF JASON     G'DAY MATE"
[Silver Spirit Coin] (silver rank, common):
A distilled quantity of raw magic. (crafting material, currency).
Effects::
 - Used to fuel silver-rank magic items or as a ritual component.
 - Consume to briefly increase all attributes to silver rank.

name: Monster Core
text:
[Monster Core]:
Monster cores are a fairly common drop item, especially with looting abilities. They are used as a part of magic rituals, both as consumed components and as a means to balance out ambient magic. The process of balancing out ambient magic is noted as being difficult especially when multiple rituals are performed in sequence.
They are also used as a means to level up essence user abilities. This process leads to faster early ranks, while stifling later progression. Many nobles and non-adventurers take this route in order to gain the longevity of higher ranks without the physical effort and peril that comes with natural progression. 
System Message:
The magic core of a lesser monster (crafting material, magic core) 
Effect: Common component for ritual magic and magic item creation 
Description: A small, red-brown gem, in the shape of a teardrop.

name: Reality Cores
text:
Reality Cores are magical objects that sustain physical reality and dimensional integrity. They are usually only accessible through Node Space, but also appear after the creation of Transitional Spaces.
These cores may be absorbed, like monster cores, to sustain and increase the strength of Essence users. They were required to sustain Gold Rank (Tier-4) essences users that were kept in suspended animation due to Earth's originally low mana levels.
Reality Cores are also used by the Cabal to make Blue Blood.

name: Monster surge
text: Every decade there is a massive increase in the spawn rate of monsters. All across the world, all at the same time. Whole villages evacuate to fortified towns

name: Astral Space
text: Astral Spaces are magical dimensions attached to a world. Unstable Astral Spaces are called Proto-Astral Spaces.

name: Proto-Astral Space
text: A Proto-Astral Space is a unstable and short-lived version of an Astral Space. The Grid was created on Earth to track all land occurences of Proto-Astral spaces. Unlike regular Astral Spaces, Proto-Astral Spaces are short-lived, and will quickly break down without intervention.

name: Spirit Domain
text:
Ability: [Spirit Domain]
This ability is evolved from the ability [Spirit Vault]. This is a secondary gift evolution.
 - You have a dimensional storage space.
 - You may call up a gate and physically enter your dimensional storage space. Only those you allow may enter; others cannot forcibly intrude. You may directly portal from within the storage space to another area using the location of the gate as a starting point, even if the gate is obstructed or destroyed, preventing ordinary egress.
 - You may summon familiars within the storage space without the use of a ritual, although any material requirements of the ritual must still be consumed.
 - You may create spirit domains that reflect your nature and power. The maximum total size of your spirit domains created through this ability is a factor of your rank and soul strength. You may not convert existing spirit domains into your own.
 - You have established a permanent spirit domain. The maximum total area your spirit domains can cover is limited by your soul strength and your rank. Current amount of maximum spirit domain established: 3266%. Increase your rank to increase your maximum total spirit domain size.
 - This spirit domain has a connected astral space. The astral space gains the full effects of your spirit domain but does not count against your maximum spirit domain size. The portals in the [Arrival Pagoda] connecting to various locations in the astral space are now active.

name: Akashic Speech
text:
Akashic Speech is a method of communication useable to its full extents only by transcendents. It is described by Carlos Quilido as being understood not by the mind but by the soul. However; without an understanding of ones own perceptions it seems to take the form of the language or method of communication most comfortable for the recipient.
Jason gains the ability to properly utilize Akashic Speech through his Numen ability.
Non-Transcendent Use:
It is mentioned by Shade that Akashic is his native language
Jason Asano's Mark of Sin affliction marks the target with the Akashic symbol of "Sin".
The Swords Dread Salvation, Hegemon's Will, and the swords conjured by Jason's Blade of Doom ability are engraved with Akashic symbols.
System Information:
Help: [Akashic Speech]:
Akashic Speech taps into the fundamental interconnectedness of all things in the cosmos to communicate in a way that is intrinsically understood by all things capable of communication. Despite the term ‘speech,’ this ability impacts all forms of communication, and is perceived by all entities in the form most natural to them. Full use of this ability is only capable by transcendent entities. Mortal limitations limit the effectiveness of this capability.
Citation:

name: Interstice
text:
Interstice is a pocket city universe without a sun.
Fueros:
Fueros is a region dominated by the cult of the World-Phoenix. It has spires of red, yellow, and orange crystal. The parks have trees that have fire instead of leaves and yellow grass.
Arrival and departure square:

name: Transcendent Beings
text:
Transcendence:
Transcendence is a state of true immortality outside of normal mortal power. There are many ways to gain transcendence; however the most common are ascending at the peak of mortal power or coming into being as such, embodying a principle of the world or universe.
Although not the only ones to wield it, Trancendents deal primarily in Authority as a means of exchange between each other, in addition to allowing Trancendents to influence the world beyond themselves.
Transcendent Beings:
Gods:
Gods are of individual worlds but not existing within it. Each god exists as an embodiment of a certain principle or concept. As gods are of individual worlds they are unable to see or act beyond that world, leaving astral spaces and the larger astral beyond their reach.
Unlike other transcendents Gods are able to create Divine versions of Essences and Awakening Stones and freely take or seal away those they have gifted.
The vessels of gods speak with power that feels backed by authority which is known as Akashic Speech. This method of communication is intrinsically understood by all things capable of communication. It is described as if the soul is what was listening.
Great Astral Beings:
Great Astral Being exist in the astral between realities as embodiments of various concepts and ideals and bound by the Cosmic Throne.

name: Astral Kings
text:
What Are Astral Kings:
Astral kings are immortal beings that rule their own universe. Their rule is complete, being able to completely change its physics or magical properties, including if the beings inside can be killed or not (completely stopping death, if the astral king wishes so). An Astral King's universe is usually comprised of at least 1 solar system with some planets. 
Prerequisites:
 - Transcendence
 - Gestalt body (merge soul and physical body)
 - Soul realm
 - Astral Throne: 
 - Astral Gate: 
 - Soul Forge: 
Old Text:
To be an Astral King, one must possess an astral throne, a realm located in the astral. The means to acquire a throne are unknown, but Jason obtained his by breaking the bridge. Astral Kings can also have astral gates, which grant them the ability to draw near-infinite power from the astral realm. Jason is just beginning to tap into this power, as his body cannot yet handle it. Additionally, kings can possess soul forges, which are very rare and have the ability to modify souls. This is all that we know about the items they can have, but there may be more that we do not yet understand. There is also a group of Astral Kings that created the species known as the Messengers.

name: Great Astral Beings
text:
Great Astral Beings are powerful entities that reside in the astral between realities. Except for the Builder most of the other Great Astral Beings operate similar to Gods in that what they want is the promotion of various ideals while none interfere with the focus of another; but unlike Gods, they cannot interact with physical realities. They can, however, recruit others to act on their ideals. 
Despite the Great Astral Beings embodying many concepts and ideals, a notable exclusion is Destiny. It is the only concept to be explicitly stated as not being the domain of a Great Astral being. 
It has been shown that the new Builder was raised up from a mortal to take the place of the previous Builder. It is unknown how many other GABs came into power like this as well, or exactly how many there are.
Jason Asano became The System towards the end of Book 11 after restoring The Sundered Throne.

The Celestial Book
The Builder

name: The Builder
text:
The Builder is a Great Astral Being who is obsessed with physical reality while, at its core nature, being unable to co-exist with it. It is building a world of its own, creating a new physical reality in the deep astral. It does this by taking raw materials from astral spaces that are neither fully of the astral or of physical reality. By giving an astral space the ability to sustain itself, even if just for a brief period, the Builder can take it and anchor it to the world it is creating from stolen parts. Since a Great Astral Being cannot interact with physical reality directly, it needs to recruit others to act for it. The Builder recruits people to carve off astral spaces connected to their world, then steps in and claims them.
Shako was the primary vessel for the Builder.
Landemere Vane was a Builder cultist.
Thadwick Mercer, Jonah Geller and three others were infected by Star Seeds supplied by the Builder.
Clockwork Kings are the source of clockwork cores that are utilized in the making of the Builder cult constructs.
The Builder was ascended to its position at 16 after the original Builder was removed.
The messenger who ascended to the position of The Builder was called Zithis Carrow Vayel
It Is unknown what happened to the original builder after he was removed from his position  since Astral beings can not die at all

name: The Celestial Book
text:
The Celestial Book is a Great Astral Being who promotes the understanding of magic’s underlying nature.
Clive Standish venerates it, as do many of those heavily involved in magical theory.

name: The Keeper of Moments
text:
The Keeper is the Great Astral Being that governs the flow of time. Ensuring the natural flow of time between universes. It is stated by shade that not even the Keeper can affect the past. It is unclear if this is due to limitations placed on it by The Sundered Throne or the nature of time. Clive's speculation about time travel when discussing dimensional travel is the primary source of the lack of clarity.
The Keeper claims no single name, preferring to not be discussed. Although Raythe the current Prime Vessel prefers "The Keeper of Sands" due to the hourglass imagery.
Known names for The Keeper::
 - The Keeper
 - The Keeper of Moments
 - The Keeper of Sands
 - The Underclock
Known Vessels::
 - Raythe [Current Prime Vessel]
 - * An Elf with green-flecked hair a lighter shade of brown than her skin.
Citations::

name: The Nameless
text:
The Nameless:
The Nameless are Astral Beings that are more numerous than the Great Astral Being and serve as functionaries. As the title/name implies they do not have names of their own. It is unknown how many exist but believed to be a in great numbers.
During the Battle of to rebuild the The Sundered Throne the nameless sided with the The World-Phoenix to stop Jason Asano.

name: The Reaper
text:
The Reaper is a Great Astral Being who advocates for the finality of death.
There was an ancient order of assassins who venerated it named the Order of the Reaper, but said order was completely eradicated from the world along with nearly all knowledge about them. Emir Bahadir and Rufus Remore are investigating the order. Jason Asano and Sophie Wexler practice a martial art called the Way of the Reaper, which was given to the assassin order by the Reaper.
Shade is The Reaper's shadow and/or child.
There is a cult of the reaper and an order of the reaper (assassins) which is a separated faction.

name: The Sundered Throne
text:
The Sundered Throne (The Cosmic Throne), is an interdimensional force that keeps diamond and transcendent rankers in check. They took Shako on The Last Ferry to "space jail", as Jason describes it. 
After the events of Book 11, the throne has been repaired and is now known as "The Cosmic Throne", which now further limits how much the Great Astral Beings can intervene with mortal affairs, causing them to be forced to work more within their roles. 
Representative/Agents of the Sundred Throne:
 - Carmen

name: The World-Phoenix
text:
The World-Phoenix is a Great Astral Being who fosters dimensional integrity, and is the one who granted Jason Asano a World-Phoenix Token, and the Nirvanic Transfiguration.
Known Vessels:
 - Dawn (Hierophant)

name: Legion
text:
The Legion (or Limitless Legion) is a Great Astral Being whom administers the cosmic rules that govern life itself.
The Legion shares a border with All Devouring Eye, Colin comes from this border region of the cosmos. The Legion is not known for handing out blessings, yet still was convinced to give one to Farah upon her rebirth as an outworlder.

name: The All-Devouring Eye
text:
The All-Devouring Eye is a Great Astral Being.
Gordon is from the realm of The All-Devouring Eye and Colin is from where they border with The Legion. The All-Devouring Eye is not known for handing out blessings.

name: Keeper of the Cycle
text: The god(dess) of death very much doesn't like resurrection.

name: Hero
text:
Hero, as the name suggests, is the god of hero's. He has no subordinate gods.
He appears to those that have decide to make the ultimate sacrifice and offer them the cup of heroes to drink from, this allows those that drink a portion of his transcendent power. This power changes the drinker into a demi god increasing their rank and giving the drinker divine versions of their essences but changes the Confluence essence to the "Hero" essence. For many though seeing Hero will be their worst day for while the power is massive it will inevitably kill them for their bodies cannot handle the power he give them to save lives, thus they will be told by hero how long they have left to live. Hero has seen untold heroes who names wont be remembered by the wider world for the actions only by himself and his priests. Hero informed Jason Asano that there where 3 occasions that the cup could have been offered to him if his intentions were different or had hero been able to see Jason.

name: Healer
text:
Healer is the god of medicine and healing. He believes that all should be made well and prosper.
While his temple in Greenstone was corrupt and needed correcting via direct divine intervention (with most of the prior clergy going to the service of Dominion), in general the church values those who wish to heal others, and work with such individuals to further aid them. In addition, the clergy contains specialized healers that make themselves available to those in need.
After the revelations about the church of Purity, the church of Healer has taken over the primary role in expunging Star Seed and healing soul damage done by The Builder.

name: Dominion
text:
Dominion:
Dominion is a god of the world and those that rule it. Their clergy serves them, rather than worshipping them. They demand obedience from their clergy.
They give the divine right to rule to the kings and emperors. They also like Jason Asano and Gary, and want to see what it takes to make them kneel.
Dominion replaced the essences and awakening stones of a number of priests of the Healer, who were cast out by their god for aggrandizing themselves and demanding money to perform healing.

name: Knowledge
text:
Goddess of Knowledge
Knowledge is one of the deities that more frequently interacts with Jason Asano and appears in a female form. She has confirmed that she knows everything that anyone in the world knows and claims to be able to see forces beyond our own perception, such as gravity.

name: Purity
text:
Purity (see also: Disguise) was one of the gods in the world of Pallimustus. Approximately 500 years prior to the start of the events of the book series, Purity sanctioned itself, expending all of its authority to create a single artifact. This appears to be the end of Purity as a god. However, the Church of Purity continued to function, and a god claiming to be Purity stepped in to continue dominion over Purity's temples and people. 
Over the course of 500 years, changes were introduced into Purity's doctrine which emphasized zealotry and militant groups, such as the Order of Redeeming Light. Additionally, humans began to be perceived as the "pure" state by these groups, undergoing rituals that stripped other races of their identity and causing changes in them that caused identification magic to perceive them as human - perpetuating a sense of superiority among humanity. 
After a series of inconsistencies in Purity's actions, such as overtly allying with the cultists of The Builder and the discovery that the purification ritual of the Order of Redeeming Light was a modified vampiric curse, Carlos Quilido comes to the realization that Purity is a fraud. In conversation with Jason Asano, Quilido initially hypothesized that Purity could be any of the trickster gods - Deceit or Disguise as frontrunners. Once this information becomes more widely known, Disguise gives up the pretense and reveals itself to have been masquerading as Purity.

name: Liberty
text: Liberty is the god of freedom. They do not get along with Dominion.

name: Vineyard
text: Vineyard is a god subordinate to the god of revels.

name: Death (God)
text: The god of death. They are in charge of guiding souls into the astral and have some influence on the potency and viability of resurrection magic.

While not as powerful as a Major good, Minor Gods (Or Profession Gods) service to provide followers and priest with insight relate to the specific role. They are concerned with the day to day lives of ordinary people

name: Vampires
text:
Vampires are entities that feed off of others. They come in a variety of forms.
 - Greater vampires are individuals who volunteered to be turned and had their souls altered by the process. They can get a variety of powers depending on their bloodline, and can create lesser vampires. They are weakened, harmed, and slowly driven insane by magical sunlight, depending on their rank and the level of magic in the sunlight. Greater vampires appear to be more common on Earth than Pallimustus . This is due to potent vampiric bloodlines manifesting on Earth as a result of patterns placed into the seed of that universe by the Builder, and possibly the low mana saturation and density leaving sunlight less damaging to greater vampires' power and sanity.
 - *The Cabal contains a large number of the Greater Vampires on Earth.
 - Essence user vampires are created by an essence user forming specific varieties of the Undeath confluence essence (often, if not always, involving the blood essence).
 - Lesser vampires are created by greater vampires and some types of monsters (possibly some death essence powers as well). They can be cured if the victim is cleansed before their body is altered too much by the curse.
 - Blood servants are not technically vampires, but are people who consumed vampire blood, strengthening them. Not only is it addictive but they lose their strength if they don't regularly consume more vampire blood.

name: The Network
text:
The Network is a coalition of local organizations using "new" magic more commonly called Essences user or as onboard earth Essences magicians. It was the strongest of the three magical factions on Earth only recently overtaking the Cabal in the last century before fracturing during the Reality Cores crisis. It is made up of unranked Humans, Essences users, Transformed, and Enhanced humans. Even Fractured they remain one of the most predominant factions on Earth.
History:
The first local branches where set up by a Gold ranked Outworlder known as The Founder who originated from Earth but became an Outworlder after traveling to Pallimustus and returning to Earth While on Pallimustus the Outworlder made a deal with a God before returning to Earth. Upon returning, they began setting up small local Network branches around the world. These local networks worked in secret beginning as secret societies. These secret societies hid the existence of magic and of monsters as apart of their core tenets. It was during this time that The Founder and his familiar Noreth also created  The Grid which was used by the new Network branches to monitor and control the magic of Earth. This new magic came into conflict this the existing magical beings, the Cabal. The The Founder came into conflict with their familiar North. When the two became  irreconcilable Noreth betrayed his bond to the American branch, which gave them a considerable head start.

name: Zartos
text: Zartos is a desert city with a subterranean river. Half the city is built underground around it. It has a large celestine community.

name: Vitesse
text:
Vitesse, sometimes called 'The City Of Flowers' is the capital city of Estercost and the home city of Rufus, Gary and Farrah. It is the site of the Remore Academy, a famous adventurer training academy run by the Remore family. It is in a high magic zone which is problematic for low Rankers since Iron Rank Monsters and Bronze Rank Monsters are not the norm and when they do spawn it is in huge numbers so Adventurers are sent out in hordes.
In Vitesse Irion and Bronze ranked adventurers are not considered real adventures, it is not until an adventure has reached silver that they are allowed to go off on their own to fight monsters. It is for this reason that Rufus,Farrah, and Gary left Vitesse.
Facts About Vitesse:
 - Vitesse has a crown princess who is a childhood friend of Rufus.
 - There is a flower wine festival
 - A recent hairstyle of Vitesse is dyed rainbow colours.
 - Clothes fashions tend towards more earthy and sober than Greenstone fashion.
 - One of the guilds is the Burning Violet guild
 - Although the location is never mentioned, Shirtaloon has placed Estercost in the French Region.

“Vitesse is as leisurely as any place you’ll find,” Farrah explained. “Culture, cuisine. Lots of money floating around, even at the low end. A labourer in Vitesse can make as much as a craftsman here.

name: Pallimustus
text:
Pallimustus, the world that Jason has landed on, is an alternate version of Earth whose continental drift has left the surface similar, though notably different. In addition to having thinner barriers to the Astral (resulting in higher mana saturation and density than Earth), it has pocket dimensions known as Astral Spaces attached to the planet in various places. Before gaining his second world map in book 4, Jason had only heard Pallimustus be refered to as "the world".  
At the start of the story, Jason finds himself in the equivalent of the African Kalahari on Pallimustus.
known countries::
Greenstone
Jayapura
Storm Kingdom
Vitesse
The world received the name Balldirt before the name Pallimustus. It was first named so by Nitrous_Hail on the discord server.

name: Earth (Planet)
text:
Jason's Earth:
This is the Earth that Jason has come from. There are several notable differences from the reader's version of Earth, with the biggest being that there is magic that has been covered up and controlled by three major rival organizations.
 - The Network
 - The Cabal
 - The Engineers of Ascension (EoA)

name: Rune Tortoise
text:
There is no Interface description for this power as of yet.
A creature with blue skin and a turquoise shell.
About a meter long.
The rune tortoise's shell has a different glowing rune on every segment. Each produces a different magical effect. 
Each rune tortoise has a different set of runes. 
Summons a Rune Tortoise familiar
Iron: Can expend runes on its body to cast different spells. User can channel mana into the Rune Tortoise to refresh the runes. When absorbed into the user it becomes a tattoo a tattoo on the users body allowing them to use to th(e Rune Tortoise's spells.
Bronze: Rune Tortoise grows larger and gains the ability to fly.
Silver: Rune Tortoise can exit shell and take on an anthropomorphic form leaving a hollow interior that can be inhabited and used for transportation. While in Anthropomorphic form the tortoise retains control of movement and rune abilities of the shell. This shell can be broken with sufficent force as demonstrated by a  in Book 9.
Appears in:
Book 1, Chapter 55: Jason battles a rune tortoise during his field assessment
Book 1, Chapter 68: First appearance of Clive Standish's familiar Onslow.

name: Sanguine Horror
text:
Sanguine Horror:
The true form of this monster is mass of leech-like monsters. According to Jason, these monsters have two purposes in life: cute little dances and slowly eating/killing their way up to become an apocalypse. The horror starts off as bronze rank with the ability to go up and down depending on how much food is given to it. Sanguine Horrors have extreme weaknesses at the lower ranks, which go away as they rank up. Their weakness to salt goes away at gold rank, allowing them to swim and munch on leviathans of the deep. It is possible to get a Sanguine Horror as a familiar both as a summon and as a bonded familiar, which requires the Sanguine Horror to be Iron rank and a correct ability. 
Essence Ability:
Colin [Sanguine Horror] (Blood)
Awakening Stone: Awakening Stone of the Apocalypse (legendary).
Incantation:
 - "Let this mortal blood beckon the all-devouring power of the final threshold. Answer the call and claim the offering. Heed my command and bring forth the avatar of life’s annihilation."
Familiar (ritual, summon).

name: Apocalypse Beast
text:
Within the universe of He Who Fights With Monsters, power is measured in layers: mortal, transcendent, divine. Yet even among the unimaginable forces that shape worlds, some creatures stand apart as forces of inevitable ruin. These are the apocalypse beasts—entities whose very existence embodies catastrophe. Unlike ordinary monsters, apocalypse beasts are not simply predators or conquerors. They are living disasters, their nature so overwhelming that their presence can alter or even erase entire worlds.
The defining trait of an apocalypse beast is not only its immense strength, but also its purpose. Where most beings pursue survival, growth, or dominion, apocalypse beasts represent cosmic archetypes: hunger without end, destruction as rebirth, infestation as inevitability. They are more concept than creature, and each encounter with them serves as a reminder that in Jason Asano’s world, the universe itself can create monstrosities that embody annihilation.
Only a few Beasts have so far been discussed as most encounters lead to a horrific end. Even races such as the messengers have had to retreat in the face beasts that have grew to full power, while using others as Doomsday weapons when invading planets

name: Soul Crest
text:
Soul Crest:
Created by a highly skilled magical tattoo artist, using an Immortal Crest as part of the ritual, Soul Crests imprint upon the user. This creates an aspect of their aura that is unique, while also drawing out a mark on their body in the form of a tattoo. Though based almost entirely upon the soul-deep nature of a person, it is also lightly shaped by the tattooist's own style. As such, some have been embarrassed by the tattoo showing their true nature, and not the one they portray. While the visible form is mutable to changes such as soul scarring events, once its mark on the user's aura signature is registered with the Adventure Society, a Soul Crest cannot be faked or mimicked by any known method, including shapeshifters, serving as iron-clad proof of identity anywhere on Palimustus.
Most of those who possess an Immortal Crest come from backgrounds of wealth and power, such as Humphrey Geller, as they are expensive and difficult to produce, while only usable at Iron Rank. Exceptions include when Immortal Crests are generated by looting powers, as in the case of Jason Asano, though this is noted as highly unusual by Tilly, the artist who applied Jason's crest.

text:
Quintessence is a form of magical manifestation that takes the form of a pieces of a complete essence, with few differences. A large amount of research has been done regarding this possibility, but has had no success.
Unlike Essences, quintessences are unranked.

name: Jason’s Lemonade
text:
System Information:
Item: [Jason’s Lemonade] (normal rank, common):
A delicious citrus drink (consumable, beverage).
Effect: Refreshing.
Crafting Requirements:
Materials::
 - 6 lemons.
 - 1 and ¼ cups of sugar.
 - 5 cups of water.
Amounts of sugar and lemon juice can be adjusted, if you like it extra sweet or with bit of a twang to it.
Tools::
 - Mixing bowl.
 - Cooking pot.
 - Mesh strainer.
 - Lemon/vegetable peeler.
 - Lemon juicer (optional).
 - Serving pitcher.
Steps:
# Wash lemons. If they feel waxy, scrub them under hot water.
# Peel the zest from 6 lemons with a veggie peeler. You want the yellow zest, but don’t be too worried about getting some of the white. Set the peeled lemons aside.
# Cover the lemon zest with 1 and a quarter cup of sugar in a mixing bowl and combine by tossing. Cover with some cling wrap and leave for at least 2 hours, but longer is better. Leaving them overnight works very nicely.
# Bring 5 cups of water to the boil, in a pot on high heat. Turn off heat and pour in lemon-sugar mix.
# Bring water to a boil in a pot over high heat; turn off heat and add the lemon-sugar mixture, including the peel. Stir, then leave as the sugars dissolve, which should be about 5 minutes.
# Strain the liquid back into the mixing bowl through a mesh strainer to excise the peel.
# Do not add the lemon juice immediately. Let the liquid sit until room temperature; about half an hour should do.
